title: 조별 과제 역할 나누기: 누가 무엇을 맡을까요?
objective: Offer to take a role and give a short reason with -는 편이다 / -(으)ㄴ 편이다.
summary: Classmates split up group-project jobs and use -는 편이다 to say what each is good at.
setting: A study room at the university. Jimin, Michael and Lin are in the same group for a class project.

task.title: Practice dividing the roles
task.line: Use the dialogue, the word list and the -는 편이다 pattern to complete each task.

words.meaning: role, part (the job one person does)
words.exampleMeaning: Has everyone decided on their role?

words.meaning: to divide, to split (work among people)
words.exampleMeaning: The four of us split the work equally.

words.meaning: to take charge of, to be in charge of
words.exampleMeaning: Who is going to be in charge of the report?

words.example: 자료 조사는 도서관에서 하는 게 좋겠어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It would be good to do the research at the library.

words.example: 내일 발표 연습을 한 번 더 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: Let's practice the presentation one more time tomorrow.

words.meaning: to be nervous, to feel tense
words.exampleMeaning: Don't be too nervous. You'll do well.
I'll go in your place today.

words.meaning: group chat room (in a messaging app)
words.exampleMeaning: I posted the meeting time in the group chat.

dialogue.korean: 오늘은 역할을 나눠야 해요. 자료 조사, PPT 만들기, 발표가 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: We need to divide the roles today. There's research, making the slides and the presentation.

dialogue.korean: 저는 발표를 맡을게요. 사람들 앞에서 말하는 걸 좋아하는 편이에요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll take the presentation. I tend to like speaking in front of people.

dialogue.korean: 좋아요. 저는 손이 빠른 편이니까 PPT를 만들게요.
dialogue.meaning: Great. I'm fairly quick at this kind of work, so I'll make the slides.

dialogue.korean: 린 씨, 자료는 언제까지 모을 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Lin, by when can you gather the materials?
I'll post them in the group chat by this Wednesday.

exercises: Change the word in brackets into -는 편이에요 or -(으)ㄴ 편이에요: ① 저는 아침에 일찍 (일어나다). ② 제 글씨는 좀 (작다). ③ 저는 매운 음식을 잘 (먹다).
Fill in each blank with one word from the list (역할, 대신, 단톡방): ① 회의 시간은 ____에서 정해요. ② 저는 오늘 못 가요. 미나 씨가 제 ____ 가 줄 수 있어요? ③ 이번 과제에서 제 ____은 사진 찍기예요.
Answer in Korean from the dialogue: 린 씨는 언제까지 자료를 올려요?
Say it in Korean: You write well, but you get nervous in front of people. Offer to take the report (보고서), and give your reason with -는 편이다.
answers: ① 일어나는 편이에요 ② 작은 편이에요 ③ 먹는 편이에요
① 단톡방 ② 대신 ③ 역할
저는 글을 잘 쓰는 편이지만 사람들 앞에서 긴장하는 편이에요. 그래서 보고서를 맡을게요.
